title: Azure Linux 3.0.2022: over 470 CVEs fixed plus the eMudhra certificate cleanup
content_md:
Azure Linux 3.0.2022: over 470 CVEs fixed plus the eMudhra certificate cleanup. Microsoft's Linux distribution for cloud workloads receives an update that closes more than 470 CVEs and removes eMudhra certificates from the trust store.

via Mastodon https://spcnet.it/azure-linux-3-0-2022-oltre-470-cve-corretti-e-la-pulizia-dei-certificati-emudhra/
